name: reset_vector
notes: JMP FAR FFF0:0000; first instruction after reset

name: reset_stub
notes: Reset stub; byte-identical in 3.08 3.11 3.12 and this image

name: xa_boot
notes: Loads the first page-register table then BRKXA 11h

name: pgr_table_first
notes: 64 page-register words loaded first at boot

name: pgr_table_second
notes: 64 page-register words in force while the OS runs

name: pgr_table_third
notes: 64 page-register words loaded by INT 10h; turns the OS code pages into RAM

name: int10_load_third_pgr
notes: INT 10h handler: loads the third page-register table

name: bios_entry
notes: BIOS start (CLI); fills the interrupt vector table

name: bios_default_iret
notes: Single IRET; target of 219 vectors at rest

name: bios_unexpected_vector
notes: Prints the System Error screen for an unexpected interrupt

name: bios_int41_dir_match
notes: Directory-entry name match used by find-first/find-next (? is a wildcard)

name: bios_mount
notes: Reads the BPB and selects a geometry slot by sectors per track

name: bios_geometry_slots
notes: Three slot pointers then three 21-byte BPBs: 720K 800K 1.44M

name: bios_int43
notes: INT 43h LCD service; AX selects the function (0-7)

name: bios_int43_table
notes: Eight near pointers: handlers for INT 43h AX=0..7

name: bios_int45_mz_loader
notes: INT 45h: load a DOS MZ file (DS:DX name; ES load segment)

name: bios_inline_string_walker
notes: Prints the NUL-terminated string that follows the CALL

name: bios_put_char
notes: BL=CL; AX=4; INT 43h; RET

name: bios_print_hex_al
notes: Prints AL as two hex digits through INT 43h AX=4

name: bios_banner
notes: Text "MPC-3000 BIOS 21/08/07"

name: amx_irq_wrapper
notes: AMX interrupt wrapper; OS interrupt handlers begin with a far call to it

name: amx_plant_vector
notes: Sets interrupt vector DL to ES:BX (refuses 0 and 4)

name: amx_copyright
notes: Text "COPYRIGHT (C) 1983 KADAK PRODUCTS LTD."

name: sys_handoff
notes: Hands control to a .SYS file: INT 10h then INT 45h then far jump

name: os_code
notes: OS application code; logical 0xB0000-0xF3FFF while the OS runs

name: os_entry
notes: OS main entry reached from the BIOS

name: startup_loader
notes: Startup-file loader; argument 0 = floppy and 1 = SCSI

name: floppy_ready_stub
notes: Far call to floppy_ready then RETF

name: floppy_ready
notes: Returns non-zero when a floppy is ready

name: put_string
notes: OS put-string used for the startup messages

name: find_first
notes: Directory find-first (INT 41h AX=9)

name: find_next
notes: Directory find-next (INT 41h AX=0Ah)

name: int41_wrapper
notes: Loads AX DX BX CX from its arguments and executes INT 41h

name: far_cdecl_specimen
notes: Smallest example of the application calling convention

name: dgroup_image
notes: Initialised data; copied to RAM segment 8010 at boot so DS offset X is file 0x20000+X

name: free_bank_low
notes: All FF; not mapped by any page-register table

name: free_bank_page61
notes: All FF; not mapped by any page-register table

name: ff_padding_in_os_pages
notes: All FF inside the OS code pages; mapped while the OS runs
